name: hcapp_reactToChatMessage
description: Adds or removes the caller's emoji reaction on a chat message of any thread kind (E9.F1.S22). Rule and write in HC6.nonApi_reactToChatMessage: same visibility as the readers, blocked authors refused, deleted messages refused. ReactionsJson is keyed by catalog code (an emoji equals '' in this collation).

parameters.name: reaction
parameters.description: A code from HC6.ChatReactionCatalog(): thumbs, heart, laugh, beer, run, fire.

rowsets.name: Result
rowsets.description: { success = 1, messageId, reactions (JSON after the change, NULL when none) } — or { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } followed by the StandardErrorResult row (1990 missing fields, 1991 not found, 1992 not allowed, 1993 unknown reaction, 1994 unhandled).

rowsets.name: PushDetail
rowsets.description: API ONLY, stripped: { MessageId, ThreadKind, EventId, PublicEventId, KennelId, RoomType, ThreadId }.

rowsets.name: SilentRecipients
rowsets.description: API ONLY, stripped: the message author's mobile devices { UserId, FcmToken } (never the reactor's own).

sideEffects: Silent FCM data push (Type=reaction) to the author's phones via AppApiHC6
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
